name: Titus Robinson
label: DATA • DECISIONS • AUTOMATION
headline: Good analysis makes the next decision clearer.
intro: I turn messy data into useful models, transparent reporting and practical tools. Explore the question, try the analysis, and inspect the code behind each project.
about: My focus is the space between raw data and a useful business decision: defining the right metrics, validating the inputs, and making the findings easy to act on. This portfolio brings together Python automation, SQL analysis, interactive reporting and careful experimentation.
contactText: I’m interested in data analyst and business intelligence opportunities where reliable analysis can make everyday decisions better.
